subject: overlapping butterfly wing scales
art_direction: 蝶翼鳞片像橙蓝色的小瓦片，从画面底部形成缓缓变化的纹理河流。
visible_description: 蝶翼鳞片像橙蓝色的小瓦片，从画面底部形成缓缓变化的纹理河流。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Explore butterfly wing scales as overlapping orange and blue tiles, photographed closely enough to reveal delicate ridges without showing an insect body. Let their rows flow diagonally through the lower two thirds, with shallow focus turning the distant scales into a calm blue haze. Use gentle lateral light and restrained saturation so the texture feels intricate yet soothing. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
